newsitem.title: UK: Anglo American set for asset sales - paper.
newsitem.headline: Anglo American set for asset sales - paper.

text.p: The world's largest mining group, Anglo American has lauched a strategic review which may lead to the disposal of non-core assets, the Financial Times said on Monday.

The review is reported to be a response to the upheaval in South Africa following the end of apartheid. Anglo is said to be seeking to expand its international mining interests and earlier this year took a stake in Britain's Lonrho Group.
In addition to mining operations, the company has widespread interests in financial services, heavy industries and the consumer sector.
The Financial Times said executives are questioning the sense of tying up capital in non-core businesses, some of which have failed to perform well.
